rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that has a low price.

example.english: The clothes in this shop are really cheap.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 di1 saam1 hou2 peng4

rows.note: Use this for something that is noticeably poor in quality or performance.

example.english: This second-hand phone is cheap and keeps crashing.
example.traditional: 呢部二手電話好渣，成日死機。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 ji6 sau2 din6 waa2 hou2 zaa1 sing4 jat6 sei2 gei1

rows.note: Use this for a person who is stingy or excessively unwilling to spend money.

example.english: They’re so cheap, they won’t even pay for a meal.
example.traditional: 佢咁孤寒，食餐飯都唔肯畀錢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 gu1 hon4 sik6 caan1 faan6 dou1 m4 hang2 bei2 cin2
